provenance.instrument: Code of the Borough of Malvern, Chapter 220 Zoning (Ord. No. 2003-8, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: Chapter 220 adopted 5-21-2003 by Ord. No. 2003-8. 220-2401 (accessory uses, with the supplemental dwelling unit in A(11)) amended 8-21-2007 by Ord. No. 2007-4. The district dimensional rules were amended in 2016 (Ord. 2016-13) and 2020 (Ord. 2020-5). The chapter is numbered 220 on eCode360. eCode360 New Laws (read 2026-11-13) list Ord. 2025-4 (parks, Ch 139) and Ord. 2026-4 (mobile food), neither a zoning change.
provenance.code_current_through_note: Code date shown in the eCode360 breadcrumb on 2026-11-13. New Laws list only Ord. 2025-4 and 2026-4, not zoning.
provenance.code_caution: Borough Council voted on 10-20-2026 on a full replacement of the zoning chapter. The borough reports that the motion failed and that the existing Zoning Ordinance and map remain in effect (one news report said the opposite). The text here is the ordinance in force. A new zoning ordinance may be proposed again.
checks: A 'supplemental dwelling unit or accessory apartment' needs a special exception from the Zoning Hearing Board in R1, R2, R3a and R3b only (220-401B(3), 220-501B(3), 220-601B(4)). R4, R5, R6 and R7 list the residential accessory uses 'with the exception of § 220-2401A(9) and (11)' and give it no special exception, so it is not allowed there

Only inside an existing single-family detached house or an existing accessory building on the lot, 'without substantial exterior modification'. No additions except an enclosed stairwell or what safety codes need. Entrances to the side or rear (220-2401A(11) intro, (a), (e))
The owner must live in the house or in the unit (220-2401A(11)(f))
Size: at most 35% of the house's total floor area and at least 400 sq ft. A unit of 400 sq ft needs a house of at least about 1,143 sq ft (220-2401A(11)(g))
One unit per lot. The district area and bulk rules apply to the lot (220-2401A(11)(c), (d))
Parking: one space for the unit in addition to the house's two, three in all (220-2401A(11)(h), 220-2501B(5))

Accessory uses stand in the side or rear yard, no further forward than the front line of the house, and have a maximum height of 15 ft. Setbacks: 5 ft side and 7 ft rear in R3a and R3b, 7 ft from lot lines elsewhere (220-2401 intro)
Two-family duplex and semidetached dwellings are permitted by right in R3a, R3b, R4, R5, R6, R7 and I4, with lot area per unit (220-601A, 220-701A, 220-801A, 220-901A, 220-1001A, 220-1901A)

In R4 a residential conversion of a house into two or more units is a special exception: lot area of the district minimum times the number of units, minimum unit sizes of 450 to 800 sq ft, not on a nonconforming lot (220-701B(2), 220-2422)
Properties in the Historic District Overlay may add multifamily residential (three or more units) by conditional use from Borough Council (220-2301E(1))
On a nonconforming lot of record a building may be built if the setbacks are met, and the use must be a permitted use in the district (220-2704C)

The zoning matrix confirms the districts: 'Dwelling unit, supplemental' is SE in R1, R2 and R3a/R3b and blank elsewhere, and 'Accessory Use, Residential does not include minor home occupation, major home occupation, or supplemental dwelling unit'. So the blanket accessory listing in I4 (220-1901A(9)) does not bring the unit there (Attachment 2, 10-01-2016)

Borough Council voted down a full replacement of Chapter 220 (a 2026 zoning ordinance that would have renamed the unit 'Accessory Dwelling Unit') on 10-20-2026. The borough says its existing Zoning Ordinance and zoning map remain in effect. A new attempt may follow (malvern.org zoning page)
In R3a and R3b the lot area table applies to 'Each dwelling unit'. Read with 220-2401A(11)(c), a house and a unit might need 24,000 sq ft (R3a) or 20,000 (R3b). Not settled (220-602A(1), B(1))

Side yards in R3a to R7 are written 'for every single-family detached dwelling ... and its accessory buildings', which competes with the 5 ft accessory setback of 220-2401. It matters only for new construction, which the unit does not allow (220-602A(3), 220-702C(1))
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Borough of Malvern. Attachment 2 (Malvern Zoning Matrix, 10-01-2016) was read from the PDF text layer on the second reading. Districts (220-300): R1, R2, R3 (R3a and R3b), R4, R5, R6, R7, C1, C2, C3, C4, I1, I2, I3, I4, LI, LI1, POSC, with a Historic District Overlay (220-2301). Read on eCode360 in a browser, section and article print views, and the chapter print view searched in the page. Searched for supplemental dwelling, accessory apartment, accessory dwelling, in-law, granny, ECHO, carriage, second dwelling, guest house, tiny, short-term, transient, boarder. No short-term rental rule in the zoning chapter. A(12) allows one boarder per single-family detached house.

term.value: Supplemental dwelling unit or accessory apartment
term.note: 'This accessory use allows a smaller secondary dwelling unit within an existing single-family detached dwelling or accessory building on the same lot as the principal dwelling without substantial exterior modification to the existing building.'

status.note: 'Supplemental dwelling unit, as per § 220-2401A(11)' is listed under 'Special exception uses' in R1, R2 and R3 (R3a and R3b). The by-right residential accessory uses in every residential district exclude A(11). The zoning matrix row 'Dwelling unit, supplemental' shows SE in R1, R2 and R3a/R3b only.

path.note: 'The following uses shall be permitted only upon the grant of a special exception from the Zoning Hearing Board'. The Board may attach reasonable conditions (220-2809).

fallback_path.note: In R4 to R7 the unit is excluded from the accessory uses and has no special exception, so a use variance. LI and LI1 allow 'Any lawful use not specifically provided for elsewhere in this chapter', which does not reach a listed use.

value.name: Two-family duplex or semidetached dwelling
value.conditions: Permitted use. A duplex has two units one over the other with a horizontal party wall. R3a: 10,000 sq ft per unit (20,000 for a duplex), width 60 ft. R3b: 10,000 sq ft per family. Side yards 12.5 ft, rear 25 ft. Two spaces per unit.

value.name: Two-family duplex or semidetached dwelling
value.conditions: Permitted use. 7,000 sq ft per unit, width 45 ft. Two spaces per unit.

value.name: Two-family duplex or semidetached dwelling
value.conditions: Permitted use. 4,250 sq ft per unit. Two spaces per unit.

value.name: Two-family duplex or semidetached dwelling
value.conditions: Permitted use. 5,000 sq ft per unit for a duplex. Two spaces per unit.

value.name: Two-family duplex or semidetached dwelling
value.conditions: Permitted use. 9,000 sq ft per unit, width 45 ft.

value.name: Residential conversion of a single-family detached house
value.conditions: Dividing a house into two or more units. Lot area of the district minimum (7,000 sq ft) times the number of units. Minimum unit sizes: efficiency 450, one bedroom 550, two bedrooms 700, three bedrooms 800 sq ft. Keeps the look of a single-family house with one front entrance. Not on a nonconforming lot or in a nonconforming structure. One space per bedroom.

value.name: Multifamily residential (Historic District Overlay properties only)
value.conditions: Only properties in the Historic District Overlay (220-2301E(1)). They may add multifamily residential by conditional use from Borough Council. Multifamily means three or more units.
value.note: The historic incentives also allow 'any combination' of uses available in the district by conditional use.

zoning_districts.note: R3 is split into R3a and R3b, both with the same use list (220-601).

building_types.note: 'A supplemental dwelling unit shall be permitted only in single-family detached dwellings and their accessory buildings.'

existing_structure_only.note: Only within an existing single-family detached house or an existing accessory building, 'without substantial exterior modification to the existing building'. No additions except enclosed stairwells or what safety codes need.

historic_bypass.note: The historic incentives add uses by conditional use. They do not change the supplemental dwelling unit rule.

requires_conforming_lot.note: 'The area and bulk regulations of the zoning district shall apply to the lot on which the supplemental dwelling unit is located.' Read as the lot must meet the district minimum. Ask the zoning officer about an older lot below it.

value.condition: Entrances to the unit are at the rear or side of the building. The house keeps the look of a single-family detached house. No additions except enclosed stairwells or what safety codes need.
A unit outside the house must be contained within an existing accessory building on the same lot as the house.
On a nonconforming lot of record, a building may be altered or erected if the district setbacks are met, and the use must be a permitted use in the district.

gates.note: Conditions from the supplemental dwelling unit standards.

types_allowed.note: (e)[1]: in the existing house, 'may be a conversion of an existing floor area, such as a garage or upper story'. (e)[3]: 'Contained within an accessory building on the same lot'. No additions, so no attached unit, and no new building.

value.garage_conversion: Unit inside an existing garage or other accessory building
value.over_garage: Unit on the upper floor of an existing accessory building

max_sqft.note: No fixed square-foot cap. Share cap only.

max_share_of_house.note: 'The supplemental dwelling unit shall be no more than 35% of the principal dwelling's total floor area'.

min_sqft.note: 'and shall have a minimum floor area of 400 square feet.'

max_height_ft.note: 'Accessory uses shall have a maximum height of 15 feet'. The unit must be in an existing accessory building, so its height is that building's, within this cap.

internal_uses_district_height.note: A unit inside the house takes the district height (3 stories or 35 ft).

front_yard_barred.note: 'The accessory use shall be located in the rear or side yard of the lot and shall be located no further forward than the front line of the principal building.'

setback_side_ft.note: 5 ft in R3a, R3b, R4, R5 and R6. 7 ft from the lot lines in other districts. See districts.

setback_rear_ft.note: 7 ft in every district. See districts.

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: The accessory use setbacks in 220-2401 apply to an accessory building.

owner_occupancy.note: 'Either the principal single-family dwelling or the supplemental dwelling unit shall be occupied by the bona fide owner of the property on which both dwelling units are located.'

family_only.note: The purpose speaks of 'the specific housing needs of Borough families', but no standard limits who may live in the unit.

max_adus.note: 'No more than one supplemental dwelling unit shall be allowed on each lot.'

sale_apart_allowed.note: Not addressed. The unit must 'remain accessory and secondary' to the house ((b)).

short_term_rental_banned.note: No short-term rental rule in the zoning chapter.

occupancy.value: Any household. A 'family' is one person, related persons with up to two others, or unrelated persons living as a single housekeeping unit.

spaces_required.note: 'One off street parking space shall be provided for a supplemental dwelling unit in addition to the parking requirements for the principal use'. The table: 'Supplemental dwelling 1 space per supplemental dwelling'.

total_on_site.note: Single-family detached dwelling 2 spaces per unit, plus 1.

min_lot_sqft.note: One acre. Width 150 ft at the building line.

setback_side_ft.note: One side yard may be 5 ft for a house, with an 18 ft height for that part (220-502D).

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: 'Each dwelling unit or other use shall have a lot area ... of not less than' 12,000 sq ft for a single-family detached dwelling. Whether the supplemental unit counts is not settled.

setback_side_ft.note: One side yard may be 5 ft, with an 18 ft height for that part (220-602A(3)(c)).

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: Same wording as R3a, 10,000 sq ft. Whether the supplemental unit counts is not settled.

setback_side_ft.note: One side yard may be 5 ft, with an 18 ft height for that part (220-602B(3)(c)).

setback_front_ft.note: No less than 5 ft and no more than 40 ft.
No less than 5 ft and no more than 35 ft.

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached or two-family, 9,000 sq ft per unit.
